title: 3 Apps In August. 21 Now.
caption:
Cursor is rebuilding GitHub's app marketplace, and it took 57 days.

Origin launched August 17 with three integrations: Vercel, Depot, Buildkite. The October 13 changelog lists 21 apps across deployments, CI, code review, security, monitoring and project management — and submissions are now open to any team building dev tools.

The part I keep rereading is the API. Origin apps sign in with app JWTs, take webhook events, and write back check runs, PR comments and reviews. That's GitHub Apps, reproduced surface for surface.

I'm still not moving. Origin isn't on free plans, and a repo mirrored from GitHub keeps its CI on GitHub, so for me it's a second tab, not a host. Would you put a repo there?

slides.title: Not On Free Plans
slides.sub: Origin needs Start, Pro, Pro+, Ultra, Teams or Enterprise. Cursor's docs: "It is not available on free plans."
